title: Write kb/_self/embedding.md, the contract for a host MCP server
goal: kb/_self/embedding.md tells a host MCP server how to embed the kb: the spawn command and working directory, KB_INDEX and KB_ROOTS, --roots with kb/public as the default for an audience outside the team, re-exposing kb_pack, kb_search and kb_show with a kb_ prefix, copying the kb's instructions and none rule into the host's tool descriptions, restarting on a census tag, and the contract test; map.csv maps kb_mcp.py and the fixture to it, and plugin.md and tools.md point to it
